name: spreadsheetSetFitToPage
description: Turns the fit-to-page print option on or off for the active sheet.

params.name: fitToPage
params.description: true to enable fit to page, false to disable it.

params.name: pagesWidth
params.description: Number of pages to fit the columns into. 0 for no horizontal fit.

params.name: pagesHeight
params.description: Number of pages to fit the rows into. 0 for no vertical fit.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Arguments are named state, pagesWide and pagesHigh, are optional, and default to true, 1 and 1. Member form: setFitToPage(state, pagesWide, pagesHigh).

examples.title: Fit to a single page
examples.description: Scale the active sheet to one page wide by one page high.
